LA PAIX DU CŒUR — TOOLKIT FOR CHURCHES
Checklist
================================================

[ ] Get your pastor’s or board’s approval
[ ] Pick the dates (ideally 4 Sundays)
[ ] Name one person in charge
[ ] Place a labelled bin at the entrance
[ ] Announce the drive every Sunday
[ ] Post the captions on social media
[ ] Write to us to plan the pick-up
[ ] Thank the congregation and share the result
